messages:
Maya: heads-up — noticed inter-region cert asserts failing for service `model-proxy` in eu-west after yesterday's RBAC prune. Error in proxy: `tls: client certificate unknown`
Chris: seeing the same across a few replicas. quick snippet from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-19T14:12:05Z model-proxy eu-west ERROR TLS handshake failed: client cert validation denied (KMS unwrap deny)
```
Arun: checked KMS audit — `Decrypt` was denied for principal `assumed-role/ephemeral-rotator` at 2026-03-19T14:11:58Z. there was an IAM binding removal in PR #4987 merged last night by ops-bot. might be correlated.
Lena: if the RBAC prune removed the ephemeral role that proxies use for unwraps, ephemeral certs would fail to validate. can someone confirm which principal attempted the unwrap?
Maya: current audit schema only surfaces `principalId` and KMS request id. no cert fingerprint or sni info to map to tenant. that's making attribution hard.
Arun: KMS doesn't capture cert metadata — that's on the TLS layer. we can augment the proxy sidecar to emit `client_cert_serial` and `cert_sha256` into structured audit events before calling KMS.
Chris: for immediate mitigation i'd prefer a soft fallback: temporarily allow decrypt from the old role for 4 hours while we rollback the prune and gather telemetry. reduces outage window.
Lena: +1. also we should avoid a broad allow — scope it to region and service via conditions. suggested audit fields to add now: `client_cert_serial`, `cert_sha256`, `sni_hostname`, `tls_protocol`, `principal_authenticated`. push as JSON fields in logs.
Maya: i can ship a tiny hotfix that plumbs cert metadata into the existing audit pipeline. runtime flag: `ENABLE_CERT_PROVENANCE=true`. minimal code change in the handshake path.
Arun: on the KMS side i can add a temporary allow statement scoped to `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ephemeral-rotator-old` with condition `StringEquals":{"aws:RequestedRegion":"eu-west-1"}` and `kms:ViaService` constraint — lowers blast radius.
Chris: i'm going to start the rollback of the RBAC prune now. DeployBot: deploy started for `rbac-prune-revert` by @Chris. :rotating_light:
DeployBot: deploy succeeded in `us-west-2`, pending `eu-west-1`.
Maya: proposed forensics / triage plan: 1) enable hotfix to emit cert provenance, 2) revert RBAC prune, 3) run handshake replay against a canary proxy, 4) verify audit entries map to principals/tenants, 5) reapply prune only after audit gating passes.
Lena: also add an alert rule: if handshake failures >5% and KMS Deny rate for client unwraps >1% for >5m, page sec-oncall.
Chris: quick command to generate cert fingerprint locally for testing:
```
openssl x509 -in client.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha256
```
Arun: i'll land the scoped KMS allow + IAM PR and add an inline condition that requires `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent` for role assumption to reduce accidental broad allow.
Maya: opening a hotfix PR now and will attach sample logs. tagging sec-oncall @Lena for visibility.
AuditBot: alert created: TICKET-2026-54321 — Inter-region client cert unwrap denies; severity P1.
Lena: after we stabilize we should schedule a cert provenance sweep job that samples handshake metadata across regions and surfaces mismatches to the audit stream daily.
Maya: proceeding with hotfix + rollback plan. i'll update this thread after the canary run. :white_check_mark:
